sourceClaims.claim: default, hover, pressed and disabled-looking paints use 16/21 typography
navigation uses a native anchor with a real href; unavailable text is a non-anchor span
visited, external and download affordances are not styled public variants

evidence.source-integrity: pass: Link.svg four-state typography and paint contract is asserted independently of generated references
evidence.structural-contract: pass: executable navigation links are native anchors with non-empty href values
evidence.runtime-browser: pass: Enter navigation updates the URL and native modifier/open-in-new-tab affordances remain unhandled by library JavaScript
evidence.accessibility: pass: native role/name, Tab focus and visible focus are exercised; unavailable text has no href or fake role
evidence.focused-visual: pass: component-local normal, real-focus and long multiline states are captured
evidence.consumer-integration: pass: three Data Workspace request IDs remain native in-page navigation links
evidence.responsive-content-stress: pass: a long link wraps inside its audited narrow surface without component overflow

staticVisual: pass: four-state source row, fake hover/pressed classes and focused screenshot remain static visual evidence only
realInteractionVisual: pass: one native anchor executes real hover, pointer-down active and keyboard focus computed paint assertions
runtimeBehavior: pass: native Enter navigation and unavailable non-anchor semantics execute independently

interactionEvidence.manualStateWalk: pass: pointer hover/down, Tab/Enter, unavailable text and narrow multiline link surfaces inspected

knownLimitations: visited, external-icon and download presentation are consumer-owned
